primitives.assumptions: Assumes the market logit is correctly identified and that coefficients are precisely zero.

primitives.name: Head Registry
primitives.verbatim_quote: There is no artifact format, no serve function, no registry, and no way to express "this stratum is certified and that one is not".
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a well-defined parent-child hierarchy and that the registry store follows the durable pattern.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Degenerates into serving the root head indefinitely when the registry is corrupted or empty.

layer2.mapping: Implements a hierarchical fallback policy in GSE's state-transition engine, allowing graceful degradation when specific head certifications are unavailable.
layer2.telemetry: Registry lookup latency, hit rate for certified heads, and frequency of parent-walk fallbacks.
